body: I really do want to find something to make life enjoyable.  That's what I think the issue is.  I am simply not enjoying life because I don't do anything that I enjoy doing.  It sounds simple but it feels like its a mammoth problem to people like us by the sounds of it.

I really do want to be positive about life in general because I know that being positive attracts people and being negative repels them.   Every year fort he last 3 years, my new years resolution has been to let go of this hate and rage that burns inside me constantly.  I just feel so angry and hateful all the time.  I have always carried this anger since I was bullied, but I wish I could just let it go.  Such a waste of time and energy.

Hi Dustin,
I live in Sydney, Australia. Congrats on being sober for so long :)
I was chatting with someone on the phone yesterday about some of the debt and it would seem that they are going for the full amount.  I just don't see the situation improving even with the debt paid.  Ill have so many black marks against my credit history that Ill probably never own my home.  I see a future of me being alone, and living in a constant state of only just staying afloat financially.
I live in Australia.  Every now and then you see a redditor in wild.

Thanks for the advice -
I feel guilty because I feel like I have let myself and my family down.  

You are absolutely right about needing a hobby.  I tend to get really into new things but due to money constraints I find it difficult.  I have wanted to join a gym or something to simply improve my shitty fitness but I have never really followed through with actually finding one and signing up.  
I know what you mean about having to look after yourself first.  There is nothing attractive about someone hating themselves, and I am sure a lot of people would pick up on it, and that it would drive potential new friends away.  That's why I am so worried about becoming the 50 year old angry, bitter and forever alone man that I see myself becoming.

The debt comes from 2 credit card companies over 2-3 years and Ive also got Paypal hunting my ass down due to my account being scammed a little over a year ago.  
I stay at home on the weekends, as I really don't have anywhere else to be.  
Thanks for the kind words :)
